s01_hello.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
s01_hello.text: You picked up. Good start. I'm Vesper, and I need someone who can drive, walk and duck, ideally in that order. There's a Kestrel in the yard. It's open. Don't make it weird.

s01_drive.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
s01_drive.text: Lovely. Now take it up the road. Gently. It's not stolen yet, technically.

s01_spotter.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
s01_spotter.text: See the suit in the park with the camera? Kurogane spotter. He's been photographing my garage for a week. Warm up first. He shoots like he's paid by the bullet.

s01_heat.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
s01_heat.text: And that's HEAT. One chevron means a patrol is curious. Get out of sight and stay out of sight until they lose interest.

s01_done.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
s01_done.text: Not bad for a nobody. The garage is yours to sleep in. Keep the burner on. When it rings in cyan, it's me.

gh01_intro.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh01_intro.text: Buyer wants a Vandal. Doesn't care whose. There's usually one sulking in a Lantern Row car park, but traffic's fair game too.

gh01_alarm.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh01_alarm.text: That's the owner shouting at a lamppost. Fresh Coat will respray it and the description goes in the bin.

gh01_fresh.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh01_fresh.text: New colour, new car, no HEAT. Funny how that works. Chop shop next.

gh01_done.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh01_done.text: Buyer's thrilled. He asked if it came in orange. It does now.

gh02_intro.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh02_intro.text: The buyer wants proof the Kestrel's quick. Deck says it's only quick when he drives it. The Kestrel's in the yard. Deck's already in his.

gh02_go.speaker: DECK · GLASSHOUNDS
gh02_go.text: Checkpoints through the Quarter and back. Loser buys noodles. I like extra chilli and winning.

gh02_done.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh02_done.text: Deck's sulking and the buyer's paid. Two of my favourite things.

gh_03_intro.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh_03_intro.text: Kurogane parked their new prototype in a Glass Quarter car park. Unguarded, apparently. Crack the lock and bring it to the chop shop, and keep the paintwork in one piece, yeah?

gh_03_alarm.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh_03_alarm.text: That's the alarm. Patrols are on you and Kurogane will send muscle. Three minutes, then the buyer walks.

gh_03_done.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh_03_done.text: Lovely bit of chrome. Credits are on your chip. Something's rattling in the boot, mind. Leave that with me.

gh04_intro.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh04_intro.text: Some Rustmouth chancer drove off in one of my Vandals. He's doing laps of the Saltworks like he owns it. He doesn't.

gh04_spotted.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh04_spotted.text: He's seen you. Lean on him until he gives up, but leave me something to sell.

gh04_stopped.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh04_stopped.text: And he's legged it. Typical. The car's open. Bring it home.

gh04_done.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh04_done.text: Dented, but mine. The Gaffer sent an apology. It was mostly swearing.

k01_intro.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k01_intro.text: We have not been introduced. That was deliberate. An analyst of ours is selling to the Null Saints. Follow his car. Do not let him see you.

k01_tail.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k01_tail.text: Keep a respectful distance. Too close and he panics. Too far and you have wasted my afternoon.

k01_photo.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k01_photo.text: He is meeting someone. I would like their face, in focus, for the file.

k01_done.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k01_done.text: Excellent. His severance package will reflect his contribution. Yours too.

k02_intro.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k02_intro.text: Kurogane purchased a yard in the Saltworks on Tuesday. Rustmouth did not receive the memo. Please deliver it.

k02_fight.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k02_fight.text: They appear to be armed. That is regrettable for them.

k02_truck.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k02_truck.text: Their truck too. We prefer our assets uncluttered.

k02_done.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k02_done.text: The yard is vacant. Accounting will be delighted, in their way.

k03_intro.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k03_intro.text: An armoured car is carrying this quarter's figures to the stadium vault. The figures are excellent. Others would like to read them first.

k03_go.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k03_go.text: Stay with it. If anything approaches the car, discourage it.

k03_raiders.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k03_raiders.text: Freelancers, closing fast. Remove them from the equation.

k03_done.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k03_done.text: Delivered, and ahead of forecast. You may find Kurogane a generous employer. Briefly.

k04_intro.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k04_intro.text: A vice-president resigned this morning and took a prototype and our drive keys with him. Find him before he reaches the tunnel.

k04_chase.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k04_chase.text: He has seen you. The prototype is insured. He is not. Wreck it.

k04_keys.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k04_keys.text: You have the keys. The police have your description. Lose them, then bring the keys to the Quarter.

k04_done.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
k04_done.text: His resignation is accepted. Do try not to resign, yourself.

v01_intro.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
v01_intro.text: Darling, Seraphine is headlining tonight and her driver has gone missing. You are her driver now. Collect her at the stadium.

v01_aboard.speaker: SERAPHINE · VELVET CHOIR
v01_aboard.text: You're new. Lovely. Don't speak, don't crash, don't take the bridge, it does terrible things to my voice.

v01_rules.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
v01_rules.text: And darling, no sirens. Seraphine does not arrive with a police escort. It's vulgar.

v01_done.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
v01_done.text: On time and unruffled. The Choir remembers its friends.

v02_intro.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
v02_intro.text: A promoter in the Glass Quarter borrowed our ledger and forgot to return it. Two of my singers are going backstage to remind him. You drive.

v02_wait.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
v02_wait.text: Engine running, lights low. Do not draw attention. They'll be out when they're out.

v02_midway.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
v02_midway.text: I'm told there is shouting. That's normally a good sign.

v02_go.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
v02_go.text: They're in, he's called the police, and the ledger is in a handbag. Go, darling. Go.

v02_done.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
v02_done.text: A standing ovation from the Choir. Well, a seated one. They're exhausted.

v03_intro.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
v03_intro.text: A rival promoter has three vans touring the city with posters of me. Unflattering posters. Cancel the tour, darling. All three dates.

v03_heavies.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
v03_heavies.text: He's sent his heavies after you. How very dull of him.

v03_done.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
v03_done.text: Tour cancelled due to unforeseen circumstances. That would be you.

v04_intro.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
v04_intro.text: Seraphine sings in the plaza tonight and Kurogane wants her contract. They are not bringing a pen. Stand by the stage.

v04_suits.speaker: SERAPHINE · VELVET CHOIR
v04_suits.text: There are men in suits in the crowd and none of them are clapping. Keep them off me until the set's over.

v04_done.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
v04_done.text: She hit the high note and you hit everything else. The Choir is in your debt, which is a dangerous place for us to be.

r01_intro.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r01_intro.text: Oi. The tide's brought salvage in all along the Saltworks. My van's in the yard. Fill it before the gulls get ideas.

r01_salvage.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r01_salvage.text: Five drops. Any order. Clock's running, because I'm paying by the hour and I don't like hours.

r01_done.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r01_done.text: Good haul. You'd make a decent scrapper if you weren't so clean.

r02_intro.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r02_intro.text: Kurogane parked an armoured hauler on my quay. On my quay. I want it. They've left a few lads to mind it.

r02_guards.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r02_guards.text: Get in the hauler however you like. Quietly if you can, loudly if you must.

r02_alarm.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r02_alarm.text: There's the siren. Lose the coppers before you bring it to my chop shop, or don't bother bringing it.

r02_done.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r02_done.text: Lovely. That's ten tonnes of armour plate, that is. I'll have it in teaspoons by Thursday.

r03_intro.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r03_intro.text: Somebody's wired my cranes to listen in on the docks. I can hear the hum in my fillings. Hack the bug off the big crane.

r03_second.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r03_second.text: That's one. There's a relay in the harbour office feeding it on. Kill that too.

r03_runner.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r03_runner.text: And there's the eavesdropper, legging it with his headphones on. Don't let him reach a phone.

r03_done.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r03_done.text: Kurogane, was it? Course it was. Those cranes have never been so quiet.

r04_intro.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r04_intro.text: Every year the crews race for the right to tax the bridges. I've entered you. Don't thank me. Your car's in the yard.

r04_go.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r04_go.text: All three bridges, back to the cranes. No rules, except winning. That one's important.

r04_done.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
r04_done.text: The bridges are ours for a year. Everybody pays the toll. Except you. Probably.

n01_intro.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n01_intro.text: Four data shards, hidden around the Undercroft. On foot. Cars are loud and the shards are shy.

n01_node.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n01_node.text: Now the test node. Watch the pattern. Repeat the pattern. It's the whole job, really.

n01_done.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n01_done.text: Handshake accepted. Mind your TRACE. It goes down on its own, unlike most things.

n02_intro.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n02_intro.text: Kurogane's got a sniffer van mapping our network. Before we kill it, I want to know where it reports. Find it.

n02_tail.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n02_tail.text: Stay on it, but not on top of it. The driver's paranoid. Professionally.

n02_wreck.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n02_wreck.text: Got the address. It's heading to the central tower with everything it heard. It can't arrive.

n02_done.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n02_done.text: Signal's dead. Kurogane's map of us now has a big hole shaped like you.

n03_intro.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n03_intro.text: Three Kurogane junction boxes, three districts. Each hack raises your TRACE. Hit a hundred per cent and they own your face. Pace yourself.

n03_one.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n03_one.text: One down. A patrol's sniffing about. Keep moving.

n03_two.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n03_two.text: Two. Your TRACE is glowing. That's normal. Ish.

n03_three.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n03_three.text: Root access. Kurogane has noticed. Shake the patrols and I'll scrub you off the grid.

n03_done.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n03_done.text: You're a ghost again. Enjoy it, it never lasts.

n04_intro.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n04_intro.text: Kurogane's sending two relay trucks to patch the hole we made. One from the north, one over the bridge. Neither arrives.

n04_escort.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n04_escort.text: They've sent enforcers to babysit. Go round them, or through them.

n04_wrecked.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n04_wrecked.text: Both relays are scrap. The patrols are cross about it. Lose them.

n04_done.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
n04_done.text: The Saints owe you. We don't say that often. We don't say much at all, on an open line.

s02_intro.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
s02_intro.text: Vesper found a data core in your Hot Chrome's boot and had the sense to ring me. It's at the chop shop. Fetch it on foot, nice and quiet.

s02_core.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
s02_core.text: Heavier than it looks, isn't it? Bring it to the rail yard. Any car. Don't drop it.

s02_rig.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
s02_rig.text: Plug it into the rig and crack it open. Kurogane encryption, so it'll fight back.

s02_lattice.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
s02_lattice.text: Oh, that's nasty. They call it the Lattice: a net of trace nodes across the whole city. Every face, every car, every second. And they just felt us open it.

s02_done.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
s02_done.text: Litany told me. A city where every car is watched is a city with no Glasshounds. This is personal now.

s03_intro.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
s03_intro.text: Vesper says you're fighting the Lattice. Good. A Kurogane courier carries its contracts to the signings, and he drinks in my clubs. His car's in Lantern Row.

s03_tail.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
s03_tail.text: Follow him, darling, but discreetly. He's nervous, and nervous men drive straight to the police.

s03_photo.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
s03_photo.text: He's handing over. I want a clear picture of whoever signs. Faces are currency.

s03_made.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
s03_made.text: Ah. His minders have spotted the flash. Leave, darling. Quickly.

s03_done.speaker: MOTHER LUNE · VELVET CHOIR
s03_done.text: That's the Lattice project lead. And the hardware lands at the docks tonight. You'll want the Gaffer.

s04_intro.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
s04_intro.text: Kurogane's landing their trace hardware on my docks and they didn't pay the toll. Come down to the cranes. Bring a car you don't love.

s04_convoy.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
s04_convoy.text: Two trucks heading for the tower, one each way, and an outrider who thinks he's hard. Wreck the trucks.

s04_wrecked.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
s04_wrecked.text: Beautiful. My lads have pulled the cores out of the wreckage and stashed them on the quay.

s04_crates.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
s04_crates.text: Three crates. Grab them. They're not heavy, they're just expensive.

s04_heat.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
s04_heat.text: Every copper in the Saltworks is coming. Lose them, then the junkyard.

s04_done.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
s04_done.text: Cores are under a tonne of scrap. Kurogane won't find them. I can barely find them.

s05_intro.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
s05_intro.text: They found the rig. They're coming. I'm loading the van now. Get here with a car, and fast.

s05_go.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
s05_go.text: Bring her to my other place across town. I'll leave the door open. Don't let anything touch that van.

s05_hunters.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
s05_hunters.text: Kurogane hunters, coming for the van. Get in their way. Ideally hard.

s05_cleaners.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
s05_cleaners.text: Bad news: they guessed where we were going. Kurogane cleaners at the safehouse. Clear them out.

s05_done.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
s05_done.text: We're in. And while you were busy I found something: the Lattice uplink. One truck at the central tower. Kill that and the whole net goes dark.

s06_intro.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
s06_intro.text: This is it. The Choir's blocked the Quarter's cameras, Rustmouth's jammed the bridges for everyone but us, and the Saints are in Kurogane's radios. All you have to do is steal a truck. You're good at that.

s06_guards.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
s06_guards.text: Tower guards. Armoured, so they'll need more than one hit each.

s06_hack.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
s06_hack.text: The uplink's lock is the best Kurogane makes. I'll feed you the pattern. Don't blink.

s06_alarm.speaker: SATO-REYES · KUROGANE
s06_alarm.text: I did say you might find us a generous employer. Briefly. That was the brief part.

s06_bridges.speaker: LITANY · NULL SAINTS
s06_bridges.text: It's got a tracker that only burns out under load. Across the bridges, fast, and it'll go blind.

s06_heat.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
s06_heat.text: Tracker's dead and every patrol in Vey City wants a word. Lose them. All of them.

s06_overlook.speaker: GAFFER ODGE · RUSTMOUTH
s06_overlook.text: River overlook. Drive it to the edge and get out. The Sable's had worse things in it.

s06_done.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
s06_done.text: Splash. The Lattice is fish food and the city's gone dark again. Every crew owes you, Kurogane hates you, and the burner's still ringing. Welcome to Vey City, properly this time.
